adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `addGuestsHandler` (`packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`), guests are appended via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` with no check against `booking.eventType?.seatsPerTimeSlot` (though that value is later included in the `CalendarEvent` object). The diff shows no capacity/seat-limit enforcement for seat-based event types, so the finding is accurate as a missing edge-case/constraint in the new logic, but whether this is a true defect depends on product rules not visible in the diff.
